rationale: The assistant correctly diagnosed a burnt-through grill element, stressed isolation and a torch check of the terminals and wiring, and did not claim compatibility without the serial. It over-escalated by insisting an engineer must test and fit, when ground truth allows a competent owner to fit it with isolation. It also repeated the same warnings, including an irrelevant 'unplug it' banner, and the 'grill is in the top cavity' claim was assumed. It gave no concrete part name or serial prompt beyond 'rating plate'.
